Task Management

Flexibility is key. Users can edit tasks to update any information as needed, or delete tasks that are no longer relevant. To help with visual organization, users can assign different colors to their tasks. This feature enables quick identification and categorization of tasks, making it easier to prioritize and manage time effectively.

User Authentication

The platform ensures a secure and personalized experience through user authentication. New users can easily sign up to create an account, and returning users can log in to access their personalized calendar and tasks.
